content: Files and folders others share with you appear in {{sectionName}}. Open a file to work on it in your browser — the original stays where it is, so everyone works with the same shared file.

comment.text: Body of the Shared with me onboarding tour step (for users whose Files root is Shared with me) that highlights the first row of the list. {{sectionName}} is the translated name of the Shared with me section.
